thread:
Maya: Need final lock on run-of-show + registration routing for Wed AM webinar. Can we confirm by 5pm PT?
Anya: Yes. Speakers are Sam (bench), Leo (demo), Nina (customer). Greenroom 08:45 PT, stage 09:05 PT.
Sam: Bench narrative: 3 slides (goal, dataset+prompt, cost/latency tradeoffs). Callout the exact prompt template on the footnote slide.
Leo: Demo plan: two handoffs — cost-tuned then latency-tuned. Ops will pre-warm KV cache and have quantized fallback. I'll paste priming prompts.
Leo: Priming prompts for ops: 1) "Condense to 2 bullets" 2) "Classify intent: purchase/faq/support" 3) "Generate 1-sentence summary"
Ben: Lead routing: registration form should add utm_campaign=webinar_march and a hidden `interest` with values `trial|nurture`. If `trial` then tag "priority-demo" in HubSpot and ping #sales. Also add `enterprise_review` checkbox to route to AE.
Nina: I'll upload the 90s customer vignette bullets by 3pm. Also open to including one slide with impact metrics.
Anya: Rehearsal: 30-min full run tomorrow 07:30 PT. Please upload slides to the shared drive by 6pm tonight. I'll send invites and the slide order doc.
Maya: Ops fallback plan: if p95 latency > 350ms switch to `rw-bench-2026-quant`; if errors spike > 2% switch traffic to staging-proxy. Leo, confirm proxy endpoint in thread.
Leo: Confirmed: staging-proxy.redwood-infer:443 ; fallback model `rw-bench-2026-quant`. Rehearsal endpoint: `https://staging-proxy.redwood-infer/run?mode=rehearsal&model=rw-bench-2026`
deploy-bot: Calendar invite for rehearsal created and sent to speakers + ops.
Ben: Draft CTA copy: "See how Redwood reduces inference costs while keeping latency predictable  request a hands-on trial". Will post updated copy after small edit.
Maya: Great. If slides + form hidden fields are verified by 6pm we lock the run. Thanks everyone!
